corrections.old_text: ማኅበር ፡ ላይ፡ ነው፡ ም፡ ፮፡ ፭፡ ም፡ ፭፡ ፲፬።
corrections.corrected_text: ማኅበር ፡ ላይ፡ ነው፡ ም፡ ፪፡ ፵፩፡ ም፡ ፭፡ ፲፬።
corrections.reason: The first cross-reference clearly reads ም፡ ፪፡ ፵፩ (Acts 2:41, referring to the 3,000/8,000 added to the community), where ፪ was misread as ፮ and ፵፩ was compressed/misread as ፭.

corrections.old_text: ፈለገ ፡ ወደ ፡ ጠርሶን ፡ ሄደ ፡ ከዚህ ፡ ምር
corrections.corrected_text: ፈለገ ፡ ወደ ፡ ጠርሶን ፡ ሂደ ፡ ከዚህ ፡ ምር
corrections.reason: The printed glyph has the 3rd-order (ሣልስ) leg of ሂደ ('ወደ ፡ ጠርሶን ፡ ሂደ'), consistent with the book's orthography (cf. Col 2 L07, Col 4 L09).
Both visually on the page (4th-order ዋ with a straight single leg and top loop) and philologically translating Ge'ez 'አስተዋፅኡ' ('contributed/pooled together'), the printed word is 'አዋጥተው'.
